ما الحد الأعلى للساعات في الفصل بالجامعا: What is the maximum number of hours per semester at Jordanian universities?
بحسب قرار مجلس التعليم العالي (17 آذار 2: Under the Higher Education Council decision (17 March 2022), unified for all universities and university colleges: 18 credit hours maximum in the first and second semesters, and 21 hours if the student is expected to graduate by the end of the semester. In the summer semester, the maximum is 10 hours, and 12 hours for a student expected to graduate by the end of the summer.
